place: 北京各國營工廠・街市糧店

title.zh: 高通膨與價格雙軌制下的北京工人生活壓力
title.en: Urban inflation, dual-track pricing, and Beijing factory workers' livelihood pressures (1988–1989)

summary.zh: 1988 年至 1989 年春，中國城市經歷嚴重通貨膨脹，糧油、副食品與日用品價格大幅上漲，部分物資在「價格雙軌制」下出現官價與議價落差及「官倒」現象，引發城市職工對實質工資縮水與腐敗的不滿。至 1989 年 4 月胡耀邦逝世前後，國營工廠車間與街巷民眾之間已積累了對物價、待遇與廉政問題的廣泛討論。
summary.en: Between 1988 and spring 1989, sharp urban inflation drove up prices for grain, cooking oil, and daily necessities across Chinese cities, while the dual-track pricing system fueled official profiteering (guandao) and eroded fixed wages. By mid-April 1989, Beijing state-enterprise factory workers and urban residents shared widespread frustration over rising living costs and official corruption.
